drivingQuestion: Is payment given after intercourse etnan?
outcomeNote: Resolution follows in the next unit

segments.he: בָּא עָלֶיהָ וְאַחַר כָּךְ נָתַן לָהּ אֶתְנַנָּה — מוּתָּר, וְהָתַנְיָא: בָּא עָלֶיהָ וְנָתַן לָהּ, וַאֲפִילּוּ עַד שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר חֹדֶשׁ — אֶתְנַנָּה אָסוּר!
segments.en: § The baraita teaches: If «he engaged in intercourse with her and afterward gave her» payment, «her payment is permitted.» The Gemara asks: «But isn’t it taught» in another baraita: If «he engaged in intercourse with her and» afterward «gave her» payment, «her payment» is «prohibited» to be sacrificed on the altar, «and» this is the case «even» if he gave it to her as much «as twelve months» later.

moves.cueHe: בא עליה ואחר כך נתן לה
moves.summary: returns to the baraita of the previous unit
another baraita prohibits even twelve months later
moves.about: payment after intercourse: permitted in one baraita, prohibited even after twelve months in another
